title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

title: The Prophecy II
description: A fallen angel (Christopher Walken) tries to prevent the birth of a child who will save mankind from the forces of evil.

title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
description: A London antiques dealer (Christopher Plummer) travels to New Orleans to save his estranged daughter from his nemesis, Count Dracula (Gerard Butler).

title: Red Eye
description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.).

title: Shutter Island
description: A 1950s lawman (Leonardo DiCaprio) pursues a murderess who appears to have vanished from a locked room within a fortresslike psychiatric hospital.

title: The Crossing Guard
description: A divorced jeweler (Jack Nicholson) tells the drunken driver (David Morse) who ran down his daughter he'll be back in three days to kill him.

title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
description: A daredevil aviator (Jude Law) and an ace reporter (Gwyneth Paltrow) fight an evil mastermind and his army of gigantic robots.

title: Congo
description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

title: Area 51
description: Obsessed with UFOs, a man (Reid Warner) and two friends find evidence of an alien presence at Area 51 in Nevada.

title: Total Recall
description: Recurring nightmares of the planet Mars lead a confused earthling into the center of an intergalactic conspiracy.

title: Event Horizon
description: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft.

title: Scream 2
description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

title: She's the Man
description: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school.

title: On the Line
description: A shy man (Lance Bass) scours the streets of Chicago in search of a vivacious woman (Emmanuelle Chriqui) he met on a train.

title: Nine
description: An Italian director (Daniel Day-Lewis) endures personal and creative crises as he tries to juggle relationships with his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz) and numerous other women.

title: The Lovely Bones
description: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path.

title: Son of Rambow
description: Though polar opposites, two schoolboys in the 1980s England work together on a homemade action film inspired by "Rambo: First Blood."

title: The Perfect Score
description: High-school students (Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg) conspire to steal the answers to their upcoming SATs.

title: Election
description: Tracy faces no competition in her high school election, but the civics teacher intervenes by encouraging the varsity football player to run for president, resulting in chaos.

title: Rumpelstiltskin
description: A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul.

title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
description: A doomed boy stalls a witch (Deborah Harry) with three tales: "Lot 249," "Cat From Hell" and "Lover's Vow."

title: The Brothers Grimm
description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

title: Best in Show
description: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

title: My Boss's Daughter
description: To impress a young woman (Tara Reid), a man (Ashton Kutcher) agrees to house-sit at his employer's mansion for one night.

title: Don Jon
description: A New Jersey bartender (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) embarks on his first genuine relationship with a woman (Scarlett Johansson), but his constant craving for Internet porn threatens to bring things crashing down.

title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
description: A resurrected ex-convict (Edward Furlong) seeks revenge against Satanists (David Boreanaz, Tara Reid) who murdered both him and his girlfriend.

title: The Crow: City of Angels
description: A magic black crow guides a motorcycle mechanic (Vincent Perez) who returns to avenge the murders of himself and his son.

title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
description: A vampire hunter (Jason Scott Lee) goes in search of medical students who hope to distill the key to immortality from the body of Dracula.

title: Comet
description: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.

title: Where the Wild Things Are
description: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

title: Clue
description: Col. Mustard, Miss Scarlet, Mrs. Peacock, and company solve a mansion murder based on the board game.

title: Nancy Drew
description: Accompanying her father on a business trip to Hollywood, the young sleuth (Emma Roberts) investigates the long-unsolved death of a movie star.

title: Escape From Alcatraz
description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison.

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: The Stepford Wives
description: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality.

title: Almost Famous
description: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: Sabrina
description: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond).

title: Like Water for Chocolate
description: The youngest daughter (Lumi Cavazos) of a Mexican family expresses her feelings in preparing wonderful food, when tradition keeps her from marrying her true love (Marco Leonardi).

title: Ask the Dust
description: In Depression-era Los Angeles, a fiery Mexican waitress (Salma Hayek) who wants to improve her lot through marriage meets an aspiring writer (Colin Farrell) of Italian descent.

title: Piranha
description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

title: Nancy Drew
description: Accompanying her father on a business trip to Hollywood, the young sleuth (Emma Roberts) investigates the long-unsolved death of a movie star.

title: Congo
description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: The Relic
description: A grieving mother who thinks her child is reaching out to her from beyond holds a seance to communicate and unwittingly unleashes evil in her home.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.
